faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about GeoRank and how it helps your brand dominate AI search results.

items.question: What AI platforms do you track?
items.answer: We currently monitor ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and more—always using the latest and most robust models available. We continuously add new platforms as they gain market share.

items.question: How often is data updated?
items.answer:
GeoRank works in two ways: keyword queries and recommendations are generated based on the training data of each AI model, giving you a baseline visibility picture. For deeper insights, our system performs a real-time deep research—analyzing your domains, keywords, and recommendations—to generate a comprehensive report on your brand's AI presence.

Frequency depends on your plan: Free updates monthly, First Movers and Starter weekly, Pro and Agency daily, and Enterprise as frequently as every hour.

items.question: What's a "GEO Score"?
items.answer: Your GEO Score (0-100) measures how often and how prominently AI mentions your brand for your tracked keywords. Higher is better.

items.question: Can I track competitors?
items.answer: Yes! Competitor tracking starts from the First Movers plan (1 competitor) and scales up: Starter tracks 3, Pro tracks 10, and Agency tracks up to 50. Enterprise plans have virtually unlimited competitor tracking. See exactly who AI recommends instead of you and why.

items.question: Can I try before subscribing?
items.answer: Yes! We offer a free plan so you can explore GeoRank with no commitment. When you're ready to upgrade, you can cancel anytime—no contracts, no cancellation fees.

items.question: Is there an API?
items.answer: API access is available from the Starter plan onwards. You can integrate GeoRank data into your existing dashboards, workflows, and custom tools.

items.question: Do you add new features and AI models over time?
items.answer:
Absolutely! GeoRank is an early-stage product with an ambitious medium-term roadmap. We update our AI models with every new generation released by each platform, ensuring you always get the most recent and capable models.

We're actively building: visibility breakdowns by model, region and audience, brand visibility scoring, source visibility metrics, citation tracking, suggested prompts, and much more. New features ship regularly—stay tuned.
